主要内容: Core Laboratories N.V. announced a cash dividend of $0.55 per share for Q3 2018, payable on August 13, 2018, to shareholders of record on July 23, 2018. The total annual payout would be $2.20 per share if maintained. Dutch withholding tax of 15% applies. Future dividends depend on financial position, earnings, capital expenditure, share repurchases, and other factors. The company is based in the Netherlands with its principal executive offices in Amsterdam. The filing is part of the SEC's regulatory requirements for public companies. The Company's outlook is subject to various important cautionary factors, including risks and uncertainties related to the oil and natural gas industry, business conditions, international markets, international political climates and other factors as more fully described in the Company's 2017 Form 10-K filed on 12 February 2018, and in other securities filings.
